# fleetcore — Maritime Maintenance Intelligence Platform
# https://fleetcore.ai

> fleetcore is an agentic maintenance operating system for maritime fleets. It unifies OEM intelligence from 100+ manufacturers (MAN B&W, Wärtsilä, Caterpillar, Kongsberg, Rolls-Royce, ABB), automates SOLAS/MARPOL/ISM compliance, and delivers predictive maintenance with 20–30% cost reduction. Built for commercial shipping operators, offshore fleet managers, and cruise lines.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://fleetcore.ai/): Platform overview, ROI proposition, and comparison to traditional CMMS systems like AMOS, SERTICA, and DNV Nauticus
- [Platform](https://fleetcore.ai/platform): Technical architecture — agentic AI capabilities, dual-interval scheduling, cross-fleet learning, vendor-neutral OEM intelligence
- [Solutions](https://fleetcore.ai/solutions): Use cases by fleet type — schedule-specific hours tracking, predictive maintenance, regulatory compliance automation
- [About](https://fleetcore.ai/about): Company background, maritime domain expertise, ADGM-registered, Abu Dhabi UAE
- [Contact](https://fleetcore.ai/contact): Demo scheduling (30-min Calendly) and enterprise inquiries
- [AI Agent](https://fleetcore.ai/ai): Conversational fleet intelligence with 30+ maritime-domain handlers and HITL governance
- [Privacy Policy](https://fleetcore.ai/privacy-policy): Data collection, use, and protection practices
- [Imprint](https://fleetcore.ai/imprint): Legal notice and ADGM company registration details

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Abu Dhabi, UAE (ADGM registered)
- OEM coverage: 100+ maritime manufacturers unified in one platform
- Compliance: SOLAS Chapter II-2, MARPOL Annex VI, ISM Code Regulation 10.3, MLC 2006
- Class society support: DNV, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, ABS, ClassNK, RINA
- Cost reduction: 20–30% fleet maintenance cost reduction vs reactive maintenance model
